reflection.candidate_lesson: When the 30-indicator consensus reports conv=100% but green_matches ≥ 3 with hist_hr ~68%, only take the signal if there is at least one green historical match; conv=100% with green_matches=0 (like EURUSD/USDJPY today) is untested conviction and should be sized at zero.
reflection.mechanism: Conviction measures live indicator agreement, but hist_hr and green_matches measure whether that exact fingerprint has ever paid out. High live agreement with no historical analogue means the setup is novel — novelty in systematic macro is unpriced risk, not edge. Institutions crowd into repeatable patterns; a pattern with zero prior matches has no crowd behind it to complete the move.
reflection.testable_rule: if consensus.conv >= 0.90 and consensus.green_matches == 0: size = 0  # require green_matches >= 1 and hist_hr >= 0.60 to trade a high-conviction signal
